card.name: Words before a contrasting 'but' clause
card.fires_on: Words in a clause that sets up a contrast or comparison, such as 'same', 'but', 'rather', or a word right before 'but' or 'than'. Mostly general prose, not drug-label text.

modes.label: Contrast markers
modes.description: The word 'but' or 'rather' that turns a sentence toward a contrasting point.
modes.example: Linux doesn't offer a reduced set of document tools,<< but>> a vastly expanded set.

modes.label: Comparison setup
modes.description: Words like 'same' or 'stable' in a claim about equality or comparison.

modes.label: Negated clause words
modes.description: A word inside a negated statement that is followed by a contrast.
